summary.short: Section 9 appropriates general fund money to the public education department for fiscal years 2023 and 2024 for listed projects. Item Q provides $290,000 for artificial intelligence equipment and consultants at ASK academy charter school in Sandoval county.
summary.long: Section 9 of New Mexico Senate Bill 192 (2023) makes appropriations from the general fund to the public education department for expenditure in fiscal years 2023 and 2024, for named statewide projects and for purposes tied to specific school districts and schools. Unless otherwise indicated, any unexpended or unencumbered balance at the end of fiscal year 2024 reverts to the general fund. Item Q appropriates two hundred ninety thousand dollars for the purchase of artificial intelligence equipment and to contract with consultants at ASK academy charter school in Sandoval county. The section contains no regulatory provisions on artificial intelligence; its other items cover education programs, equipment, vehicles and facilities. One item (Albuquerque, item C(1)) requires a report to the legislative education study committee by October 1, 2024 on program effects.

thresholds.note: Section 9 is a general-fund appropriations provision. Its dollar figures allocate funds to named recipients for stated purposes and do not set a cutoff at which the legal treatment of any person changes. The provision reverts unexpended balances to the general fund at the end of fiscal year 2024, which is a timing rule, not a threshold. The October 1, 2024 report date is a procedural deadline and is not coded here.
